question: What was the yearly trend in Luxembourg's fuel imports unit value (price per kg) for mineral fuels and oils from 2018 to 2023?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs2 IN ('27')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: +57.7 % (2018–2023)
insight: The yearly trend in Luxembourg's fuel imports unit value for mineral fuels and oils increased from 0.59 euros per kilogram in 2018 to 0.93 euros per kilogram in 2023.
This represents a rise of 57.7% over the five-year period.
The highest unit value was recorded in 2023 at 0.93 euros per kilogram.
The data only includes trade rows where quantities are known, so some volumes and unit values may be missing.
